description: Commit 52a3704 added `pub updated_properties: Option<Vec<String>>` to the base `ChangesResponse` type in jmap-types. The doc-comment correctly notes this field is only meaningful for RFC 8621 §2.2 (Mailbox/changes) and RFC 9425 §5 (Quota/changes). Concern: jmap-types is the foundation. Carrying a Mailbox+Quota-specific extension field on the base type leaks two extension specs into the foundation. Better alternatives that were not pursued: (a) define ChangesResponse as a generic that takes a per-type extension struct, e.g. `ChangesResponse<Ext = ()> { /* base fields */, ext: Ext }`; (b) define MailboxChangesResponse and QuotaChangesResponse as separate types in their respective extension crates that delegate via composition; (c) leave updated_properties as a flatten extras field that mail/quota types explicitly read. Maintenance cost: every future /changes extension (jmap-sharing, jmap-tasks, etc.) will face pressure to add their own typed field here "for parity" — same drift pattern that the chat-cap-stripping bead (JMAP-kt5k) just had to undo. The chosen approach (carry on base) is wire-compatible but fossilizes a coupling. Surface the architectural decision explicitly.
title: ChangesResponse.updated_properties on base type couples Mailbox+Quota spec extensions into the foundation
